description: This file defines a custom WebApplicationFactory for functional tests in an ASP.NET Core application. It configures a test host environment with in-memory databases to replace production database contexts, facilitating testing of web components in isolation.

classes.name: TestApplication
classes.description: A custom WebApplicationFactory subclass configured for testing, which sets up in-memory databases for CatalogContext and AppIdentityDbContext, replacing actual database configurations during tests.

methods.name: CreateHost
methods.description: Overrides the CreateHost method to configure the host environment for tests, replacing database contexts with in-memory databases.
